'''''Reboulia hemisphaerica''''', the '''hemisphaeric liverwort'''<ref name="BBS" /> or '''small mushroom-headed liverwort''',<ref name="BBS" /> is the only species of [[liverwort]] in the genus '''''Reboulia'''''.

A possible second species ''Reboulia queenslandica'' (Stephani) M. Hicks was published in 1992,<ref name="Hicks 1992" /> but it was later determined to be a [[polyploid]] cross between two varieties of ''R. hemisphaerica'', so not a distinct species.<ref name="Boisselier-Dubayle 1998" /> Subsequent lists and publications do not recognize it as distinct.<ref name="Söderström 2016" />

[[Riccardin C]] is a phenolic cyclic bibenzyl secondary metabolite isolated from ''R. hemisphaerica'',<ref name="Asakawa 1982" /> as is marchantinquinone.<ref name="Ko 1995" />
